dimensions.assessment: Affects small bank holding companies and savings and loan holding companies by raising their asset threshold.
dimensions.evidence: for any bank holding company or savings and loan holding company.

dimensions.assessment: Alters the regulatory threshold and debt allowance standards for covered holding companies.
dimensions.evidence: allow small bank holding companies to operate with higher debt levels than would be allowed for larger bank holding companies.

dimensions.assessment: The source material mentions no direct federal spending or revenue changes.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Federal Reserve to raise the consolidated asset threshold to $25 billion for small bank holding companies and savings and loan holding companies under its policy statement, allowing them to operate with higher debt levels.
